records.title: Status of Siliguri-Jhapa Petroleum pipeline project
details: a to e: Pre-construction work for the Siliguri-Jhapa Petroleum Pipeline (SJPL) project is currently in progress.

records.title: Indian Statistical Institute Bill, 2025
details: e: The process of Cabinet approval has been initiated. The matter is under consideration in accordance with the prescribed procedure.

records.title: Voluntary exit of Calcutta stock exchange under SEBI Exit Policy
details: a to b: (a) & (b): The Calcutta Stock Exchange (CSE), vide letter dated February 18, 2025, submitted an application to the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) seeking voluntary exit as a Stock Exchange under the SEBI Exit Policy for Stock Exchanges dated May 30,2012. The proposal is at the stage of examination before SEBI.

records.title: Arsenic-Free Piped Drinking Water in Nadia District
details: c to e): Hon'ble Finance Minister during her budget speech 2025-26 has announced extension of Jal Jeevan Mission until 2028 with enhanced total outlay. Accordingly, a proposal, for continuation of Jal Jeevan Mission until 2028 with enhanced total outlay is under active consideration of the Government.

records.title: Development of IIIT Kalyani
details: a to f: 28 additional faculty positions have been created and recruitment to these positions has been initiated.

records.title: IACS smart campus at Baruipur
details: a: The Department of Science and Technology has received only a concept note from Indian Association for Cultivation of Science (IACS) seeking in-principle approval for development of IACS SMART Campus at Baruipur. The said note is Currently under evaluation for its feasibility.

records.title: Progress of interception and diversion treatment works at ADI Ganga.
details: The revised DPR for the pollution Abatement Work for the Rejuvenation of River Adi Ganga (Tolly Nullah), Kolkata Project was approved in the 46th EC meeting held on 23rd December 2022, with a total project cost of Rs. 653.67 crores under the externally aided project (EAP) component (World Bank funded). The project is currently in the tendering stage.
